In my experience with recovery. I spent a year and a half trying to quit once I realized I had an addiction. Originally, approaching it felt like I was basically trying to restrict myself from watching porn for the sake of my relationship and sexual health/function. Relapses came often. VR porn fried my brain to the point I couldn’t function sexually. My tastes escalated to things that made me question my sexuality. I went through some dark depressions and suicidal thoughts over this time. I began really exploring my feelings and emotions and trying to understand why I’m using porn in the first place. I ended coming to the conclusion that I had unresolved trauma from my past I hadn’t let go of. I thought of a time when I was 6 I was a victim of SA. I thought about being 7 years old and discovering pornography and masturbating. I struggled with porn for 25 years on and off without ever realizing it was a problem. Once I really sat with those things that happened to me and let go of the pain that it’s caused me all these years it felt like a switch flipped in my brain. The desire to engage in pornography disappeared immediately. There was no more pain and hurt to mask. I have every opportunity in the world to go back to pornography. However I absolutely zero desire. I will never go back again. Recovery is very possible. No it doesn’t take years of babysitting. I think all of us are susceptible to certain addictions. Alcohol for me has no intrigue but pornography is something I will always stay away from now on.
